title: 东北证券 API Key 配置
description: 连接东北证券 MCP，用自然语言查询 A 股、港股、基金与宏观行业的行情、财务、估值、资金流、公告、研报、资讯舆情等结构化数据，支持多维选股、多维选基、行业速报、政策解读与舆情风险预警等。Token 与接口地址仅存储在本机~/.workbuddy 下。
description_en: Connect to the Northeast Securities MCP to query structured data in natural language — quotes, financials, valuation, fund flows, announcements, research reports and news sentiment for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, funds and macro industries — supporting multi-dimensional stock screening, fund screening, industry briefs, policy interpretation and sentiment risk alerts. The token and endpoint URL are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy on your machine only.
docLabel: 如何登录开通引导页面获取 API Key 并配置东北证券 MCP
docLabel_en: How to sign in and get your Northeast Securities API Key, then configure the MCP
